+Phase 6D Recommendation Campaign Follow-Up Proposal Governance Ratification
+===========================================================================
 
-Purpose and recovered roadmap
------------------------------
+Purpose and distinct authority
+------------------------------
 
-Phase 6D records one immutable administrative ratification for one exact eligible
-Phase 6C follow-up-proposal review event.  The committed Phase 6A roadmap
-separates Phase 6B--6F into persistence, review, ratification/rejection,
-activation, and execution concerns.  Phase 6C uses ``approved`` and
-``rejected`` as its review outcomes, but explicitly defines an approved review
-as evidence for possible consideration by a later separately authorized
-phase.  Phase 6D is that distinct administrative ratification boundary; it is not
-the later activation or execution boundary.
+Phase 6C and Phase 6D answer different governance questions.
 
-Only an exact persisted Phase 6C ``approved`` review is eligible.  A rejected,
-missing, malformed, stale, identity-inconsistent, or unsupported review cannot
-be approved.  Phase 6D never rebuilds the Phase 6A proposal or recomputes the
-Phase 5 assessment/policy decision.  It loads the authoritative Phase 6C
-record, whose validated repository reload in turn verifies the exact persisted
-Phase 6B proposal and complete Phase 6A identity.
+Phase 6C asks whether one exact persisted Phase 6B follow-up proposal is
+acceptable on its merits for possible advancement.  An identified reviewer
+records one immutable ``approved`` or ``rejected`` administrative review.
 
+Phase 6D asks whether, given that exact approved review and its complete
+authoritative provenance, an authorized governance actor ratifies advancement
+of the reviewed proposal into the next separately controlled phase.  The only
+positive Phase 6D decision is ``ratified``.  Ratification is immutable
+governance evidence; it does not grant any capability in Phase 6E.
+
+Eligibility and separation of duties
+------------------------------------
+
+Only one exact persisted, fully reloadable Phase 6C ``approved`` review is
+eligible.  A rejected, missing, malformed, stale, unsupported, or
+identity-inconsistent review fails closed.  The ratifier identity must differ
+byte-for-byte from the Phase 6C reviewer identity.  Self-ratification is
+rejected by pure construction, service and repository validation, a database
+check constraint, and the provenance trigger.
+
+The ratifier acts under the fixed version-1 role
+``follow_up_governance_ratifier``.  Callers cannot select or inject a different
+role.  Phase 6D never rebuilds the Phase 6A proposal or recomputes Phase 5
+assessment or policy truth; validated Phase 6C reload transitively validates
+the exact persisted Phase 6B proposal and embedded Phase 6A identity.
+

+bool ReviewIdentityMatchesPayload(
+    int reviewContractVersion,
+    const std::string& reviewCanonicalText,
+    const std::string& reviewIdentityHash,
+    long long followUpProposalId,
+    int proposalContractVersion,
+    const std::string& proposalCanonicalText,
+    const std::string& proposalIdentityHash,
+    RecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalReviewDecision reviewDecision,
+    const std::string& reviewerIdentity)
+{
+    const std::string marker =
+        ";reviewer=" + LengthPrefixed(reviewerIdentity) + ";reason=";
+    std::size_t markerPosition = reviewCanonicalText.find(marker);
+    while (markerPosition != std::string::npos)
+    {
+        const std::size_t lengthPosition = markerPosition + marker.size();
+        const std::size_t colonPosition =
+            reviewCanonicalText.find(':', lengthPosition);
+        if (colonPosition != std::string::npos &&
+            colonPosition > lengthPosition)
+        {
+            std::size_t reasonLength = 0U;
+            bool validLength = true;
+            for (std::size_t index = lengthPosition;
+                 index < colonPosition; ++index)
+            {
+                const unsigned char character =
+                    static_cast<unsigned char>(reviewCanonicalText[index]);
+                if (character < '0' || character > '9')
+                {
+                    validLength = false;
+                    break;
+                }
+                const std::size_t digit = character - '0';
+                if (reasonLength >
+                    (std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max() - digit) / 10U)
+                {
+                    validLength = false;
+                    break;
+                }
+                reasonLength = reasonLength * 10U + digit;
+            }
+            const std::size_t reasonPosition = colonPosition + 1U;
+            if (validLength && reasonLength ==
+                    reviewCanonicalText.size() - reasonPosition)
+            {
+                try
+                {
+                    const auto review =
+                        BuildRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalReview(
+                            reviewContractVersion, followUpProposalId,
+                            proposalContractVersion, proposalCanonicalText,
+                            proposalIdentityHash, reviewDecision,
+                            reviewerIdentity,
+                            reviewCanonicalText.substr(reasonPosition));
+                    if (review.identity.canonicalText == reviewCanonicalText &&
+                        review.identity.hash == reviewIdentityHash)
+                        return true;
+                }
+                catch (const std::exception&)
+                {
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        markerPosition = reviewCanonicalText.find(
+            marker, markerPosition + 1U);
+    }
+    return false;
+}

+bool ReviewIdentityMatchesPayload(
+    int reviewContractVersion,
+    const std::string& reviewCanonicalText,
+    const std::string& reviewIdentityHash,
+    long long followUpProposalId,
+    int proposalContractVersion,
+    const std::string& proposalCanonicalText,
+    const std::string& proposalIdentityHash,
+    RecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalReviewDecision reviewDecision,
+    const std::string& reviewerIdentity)
+{
+    const std::string marker =
+        ";reviewer=" + LengthPrefixed(reviewerIdentity) + ";reason=";
+    std::size_t markerPosition = reviewCanonicalText.find(marker);
+    while (markerPosition != std::string::npos)
+    {
+        const std::size_t lengthPosition = markerPosition + marker.size();
+        const std::size_t colonPosition =
+            reviewCanonicalText.find(':', lengthPosition);
+        if (colonPosition != std::string::npos &&
+            colonPosition > lengthPosition)
+        {
+            std::size_t reasonLength = 0U;
+            bool validLength = true;
+            for (std::size_t index = lengthPosition;
+                 index < colonPosition; ++index)
+            {
+                const unsigned char character =
+                    static_cast<unsigned char>(reviewCanonicalText[index]);
+                if (character < '0' || character > '9')
+                {
+                    validLength = false;
+                    break;
+                }
+                const std::size_t digit = character - '0';
+                if (reasonLength >
+                    (std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max() - digit) / 10U)
+                {
+                    validLength = false;
+                    break;
+                }
+                reasonLength = reasonLength * 10U + digit;
+            }
+            const std::size_t reasonPosition = colonPosition + 1U;
+            if (validLength && reasonLength ==
+                    reviewCanonicalText.size() - reasonPosition)
+            {
+                try
+                {
+                    const auto review =
+                        BuildRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalReview(
+                            reviewContractVersion, followUpProposalId,
+                            proposalContractVersion, proposalCanonicalText,
+                            proposalIdentityHash, reviewDecision,
+                            reviewerIdentity,
+                            reviewCanonicalText.substr(reasonPosition));
+                    if (review.identity.canonicalText == reviewCanonicalText &&
+                        review.identity.hash == reviewIdentityHash)
+                        return true;
+                }
+                catch (const std::exception&)
+                {
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        markerPosition = reviewCanonicalText.find(
+            marker, markerPosition + 1U);
+    }
+    return false;
+}

template <typename Function>
void AssertReason(Function&& function, const std::string& expected)
{
    bool threw = false;
    try
    {
        function();
    }
    catch (const std::exception& error)
    {
        threw = true;
        assert(error.what() == expected);
    }
    assert(threw);
}

bool IsAsciiAlphanumeric(unsigned char character)
{
    return (character >= 'a' && character <= 'z') ||
        (character >= 'A' && character <= 'Z') ||
        (character >= '0' && character <= '9');
}

bool IsValidReviewerIdentity(const std::string& value)
{
    if (value.empty() ||
        value.size() >
            kMaximumRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalReviewerIdentityBytes ||
        !IsAsciiAlphanumeric(static_cast<unsigned char>(value.front())))
        return false;
    for (const unsigned char character : value)
    {
        if (!IsAsciiAlphanumeric(character) && character != '.' &&
            character != '_' && character != '@' && character != ':' &&
            character != '/' && character != '+' && character != '-')
            return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool IsValidUtf8(const std::string& value)
{
    const auto* bytes = reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>(value.data());
    std::size_t index = 0;
    while (index < value.size())
    {
        const unsigned char first = bytes[index];
        if (first <= 0x7fU)
        {
            ++index;
            continue;
        }
        std::size_t continuationCount = 0;
        unsigned int codePoint = 0;
        if (first >= 0xc2U && first <= 0xdfU)
        {
            continuationCount = 1;
            codePoint = first & 0x1fU;
        }

bool ValidCanonicalIdentity(
    const std::string& canonicalText,
    const std::string& hash)
{
    return !canonicalText.empty() &&
        canonicalText.find('\0') == std::string::npos &&
        hash == RecommendationCanonicalHash(canonicalText);
}

+bool ReviewIdentityMatchesPayload(
+    int reviewContractVersion,
+    const std::string& reviewCanonicalText,
+    const std::string& reviewIdentityHash,
+    long long followUpProposalId,
+    int proposalContractVersion,
+    const std::string& proposalCanonicalText,
+    const std::string& proposalIdentityHash,
+    RecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalReviewDecision reviewDecision,
+    const std::string& reviewerIdentity)
+{
+    const std::string marker =
+        ";reviewer=" + LengthPrefixed(reviewerIdentity) + ";reason=";
+    std::size_t markerPosition = reviewCanonicalText.find(marker);
+    while (markerPosition != std::string::npos)
+    {
+        const std::size_t lengthPosition = markerPosition + marker.size();
+        const std::size_t colonPosition =
+            reviewCanonicalText.find(':', lengthPosition);
+        if (colonPosition != std::string::npos &&
+            colonPosition > lengthPosition)
+        {
+            std::size_t reasonLength = 0U;
+            bool validLength = true;
+            for (std::size_t index = lengthPosition;
+                 index < colonPosition; ++index)
+            {
+                const unsigned char character =
+                    static_cast<unsigned char>(reviewCanonicalText[index]);
+                if (character < '0' || character > '9')
+                {
+                    validLength = false;
+                    break;
+                }
+                const std::size_t digit = character - '0';
+                if (reasonLength >
+                    (std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max() - digit) / 10U)
+                {
+                    validLength = false;
+                    break;
+                }
+                reasonLength = reasonLength * 10U + digit;
+            }
+            const std::size_t reasonPosition = colonPosition + 1U;
+            if (validLength && reasonLength ==
+                    reviewCanonicalText.size() - reasonPosition)
+            {
+                try
+                {
+                    const auto review =
+                        BuildRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalReview(
+                            reviewContractVersion, followUpProposalId,
+                            proposalContractVersion, proposalCanonicalText,
+                            proposalIdentityHash, reviewDecision,
+                            reviewerIdentity,
+                            reviewCanonicalText.substr(reasonPosition));
+                    if (review.identity.canonicalText == reviewCanonicalText &&
+                        review.identity.hash == reviewIdentityHash)
+                        return true;
+                }
+                catch (const std::exception&)
+                {
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        markerPosition = reviewCanonicalText.find(
+            marker, markerPosition + 1U);
+    }
+    return false;
+}

+bool ReviewIdentityMatchesPayload(
+    int reviewContractVersion,
+    const std::string& reviewCanonicalText,
+    const std::string& reviewIdentityHash,
+    long long followUpProposalId,
+    int proposalContractVersion,
+    const std::string& proposalCanonicalText,
+    const std::string& proposalIdentityHash,
+    RecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalReviewDecision reviewDecision,
+    const std::string& reviewerIdentity)
+{
+    const std::string marker =
+        ";reviewer=" + LengthPrefixed(reviewerIdentity) + ";reason=";
+    std::size_t markerPosition = reviewCanonicalText.find(marker);
+    while (markerPosition != std::string::npos)
+    {
+        const std::size_t lengthPosition = markerPosition + marker.size();
+        const std::size_t colonPosition =
+            reviewCanonicalText.find(':', lengthPosition);
+        if (colonPosition != std::string::npos &&
+            colonPosition > lengthPosition)
+        {
+            std::size_t reasonLength = 0U;
+            bool validLength = true;
+            for (std::size_t index = lengthPosition;
+                 index < colonPosition; ++index)
+            {
+                const unsigned char character =
+                    static_cast<unsigned char>(reviewCanonicalText[index]);
+                if (character < '0' || character > '9')
+                {
+                    validLength = false;
+                    break;
+                }
+                const std::size_t digit = character - '0';
+                if (reasonLength >
+                    (std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max() - digit) / 10U)
+                {
+                    validLength = false;
+                    break;
+                }
+                reasonLength = reasonLength * 10U + digit;
+            }
+            const std::size_t reasonPosition = colonPosition + 1U;
+            if (validLength && reasonLength ==
+                    reviewCanonicalText.size() - reasonPosition)
+            {
+                try
+                {
+                    const auto review =
+                        BuildRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalReview(
+                            reviewContractVersion, followUpProposalId,
+                            proposalContractVersion, proposalCanonicalText,
+                            proposalIdentityHash, reviewDecision,
+                            reviewerIdentity,
+                            reviewCanonicalText.substr(reasonPosition));
+                    if (review.identity.canonicalText == reviewCanonicalText &&
+                        review.identity.hash == reviewIdentityHash)
+                        return true;
+                }
+                catch (const std::exception&)
+                {
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        markerPosition = reviewCanonicalText.find(
+            marker, markerPosition + 1U);
+    }
+    return false;
+}

+bool ReviewIdentityMatchesPayload(
+    int reviewContractVersion,
+    const std::string& reviewCanonicalText,
+    const std::string& reviewIdentityHash,
+    long long followUpProposalId,
+    int proposalContractVersion,
+    const std::string& proposalCanonicalText,
+    const std::string& proposalIdentityHash,
+    RecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalReviewDecision reviewDecision,
+    const std::string& reviewerIdentity)
+{
+    const std::string marker =
+        ";reviewer=" + LengthPrefixed(reviewerIdentity) + ";reason=";
+    std::size_t markerPosition = reviewCanonicalText.find(marker);
+    while (markerPosition != std::string::npos)
+    {
+        const std::size_t lengthPosition = markerPosition + marker.size();
+        const std::size_t colonPosition =
+            reviewCanonicalText.find(':', lengthPosition);
+        if (colonPosition != std::string::npos &&
+            colonPosition > lengthPosition)
+        {
+            std::size_t reasonLength = 0U;
+            bool validLength = true;
+            for (std::size_t index = lengthPosition;
+                 index < colonPosition; ++index)
+            {
+                const unsigned char character =
+                    static_cast<unsigned char>(reviewCanonicalText[index]);
+                if (character < '0' || character > '9')
+                {
+                    validLength = false;
+                    break;
+                }
+                const std::size_t digit = character - '0';
+                if (reasonLength >
+                    (std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max() - digit) / 10U)
+                {
+                    validLength = false;
+                    break;
+                }
+                reasonLength = reasonLength * 10U + digit;
+            }
+            const std::size_t reasonPosition = colonPosition + 1U;
+            if (validLength && reasonLength ==
+                    reviewCanonicalText.size() - reasonPosition)
+            {
+                try
+                {
+                    const auto review =
+                        BuildRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalReview(
+                            reviewContractVersion, followUpProposalId,
+                            proposalContractVersion, proposalCanonicalText,
+                            proposalIdentityHash, reviewDecision,
+                            reviewerIdentity,
+                            reviewCanonicalText.substr(reasonPosition));
+                    if (review.identity.canonicalText == reviewCanonicalText &&
+                        review.identity.hash == reviewIdentityHash)
+                        return true;
+                }
+                catch (const std::exception&)
+                {
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        markerPosition = reviewCanonicalText.find(
+            marker, markerPosition + 1U);
+    }
+    return false;
+}

+bool ReviewIdentityMatchesPayload(
+    int reviewContractVersion,
+    const std::string& reviewCanonicalText,
+    const std::string& reviewIdentityHash,
+    long long followUpProposalId,
+    int proposalContractVersion,
+    const std::string& proposalCanonicalText,
+    const std::string& proposalIdentityHash,
+    RecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalReviewDecision reviewDecision,
+    const std::string& reviewerIdentity)
+{
+    const std::string marker =
+        ";reviewer=" + LengthPrefixed(reviewerIdentity) + ";reason=";
+    std::size_t markerPosition = reviewCanonicalText.find(marker);
+    while (markerPosition != std::string::npos)
+    {
+        const std::size_t lengthPosition = markerPosition + marker.size();
+        const std::size_t colonPosition =
+            reviewCanonicalText.find(':', lengthPosition);
+        if (colonPosition != std::string::npos &&
+            colonPosition > lengthPosition)
+        {
+            std::size_t reasonLength = 0U;
+            bool validLength = true;
+            for (std::size_t index = lengthPosition;
+                 index < colonPosition; ++index)
+            {
+                const unsigned char character =
+                    static_cast<unsigned char>(reviewCanonicalText[index]);
+                if (character < '0' || character > '9')
+                {
+                    validLength = false;
+                    break;
+                }
+                const std::size_t digit = character - '0';
+                if (reasonLength >
+                    (std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max() - digit) / 10U)
+                {
+                    validLength = false;
+                    break;
+                }
+                reasonLength = reasonLength * 10U + digit;
+            }
+            const std::size_t reasonPosition = colonPosition + 1U;
+            if (validLength && reasonLength ==
+                    reviewCanonicalText.size() - reasonPosition)
+            {
+                try
+                {
+                    const auto review =
+                        BuildRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalReview(
+                            reviewContractVersion, followUpProposalId,
+                            proposalContractVersion, proposalCanonicalText,
+                            proposalIdentityHash, reviewDecision,
+                            reviewerIdentity,
+                            reviewCanonicalText.substr(reasonPosition));
+                    if (review.identity.canonicalText == reviewCanonicalText &&
+                        review.identity.hash == reviewIdentityHash)
+                        return true;
+                }
+                catch (const std::exception&)
+                {
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        markerPosition = reviewCanonicalText.find(
+            marker, markerPosition + 1U);
+    }
+    return false;
+}

+    while (markerPosition != std::string::npos)
+    {
+        const std::size_t lengthPosition = markerPosition + marker.size();
+        const std::size_t colonPosition =
+            reviewCanonicalText.find(':', lengthPosition);
+        if (colonPosition != std::string::npos &&
+            colonPosition > lengthPosition)
+        {
+            std::size_t reasonLength = 0U;
+            bool validLength = true;
+            for (std::size_t index = lengthPosition;
+                 index < colonPosition; ++index)
+            {
+                const unsigned char character =
+                    static_cast<unsigned char>(reviewCanonicalText[index]);
+                if (character < '0' || character > '9')
+                {
+                    validLength = false;
+                    break;
+                }
+                const std::size_t digit = character - '0';
+                if (reasonLength >
+                    (std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max() - digit) / 10U)
+                {
+                    validLength = false;
+                    break;
+                }
+                reasonLength = reasonLength * 10U + digit;
+            }
+            const std::size_t reasonPosition = colonPosition + 1U;
+            if (validLength && reasonLength ==
+                    reviewCanonicalText.size() - reasonPosition)
+            {
+                try
+                {
+                    const auto review =
+                        BuildRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalReview(
+                            reviewContractVersion, followUpProposalId,
+                            proposalContractVersion, proposalCanonicalText,
+                            proposalIdentityHash, reviewDecision,
+                            reviewerIdentity,
+                            reviewCanonicalText.substr(reasonPosition));
+                    if (review.identity.canonicalText == reviewCanonicalText &&
+                        review.identity.hash == reviewIdentityHash)
+                        return true;
+                }
+                catch (const std::exception&)
+                {
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        markerPosition = reviewCanonicalText.find(
+            marker, markerPosition + 1U);
+    }
+    return false;
+}

+Phase 6D Recommendation Campaign Follow-Up Proposal Governance Ratification
+===========================================================================
 
-Purpose and recovered roadmap
------------------------------
+Purpose and distinct authority
+------------------------------
 
-Phase 6D records one immutable administrative ratification for one exact eligible
-Phase 6C follow-up-proposal review event.  The committed Phase 6A roadmap
-separates Phase 6B--6F into persistence, review, ratification/rejection,
-activation, and execution concerns.  Phase 6C uses ``approved`` and
-``rejected`` as its review outcomes, but explicitly defines an approved review
-as evidence for possible consideration by a later separately authorized
-phase.  Phase 6D is that distinct administrative ratification boundary; it is not
-the later activation or execution boundary.
+Phase 6C and Phase 6D answer different governance questions.
 
-Only an exact persisted Phase 6C ``approved`` review is eligible.  A rejected,
-missing, malformed, stale, identity-inconsistent, or unsupported review cannot
-be approved.  Phase 6D never rebuilds the Phase 6A proposal or recomputes the
-Phase 5 assessment/policy decision.  It loads the authoritative Phase 6C
-record, whose validated repository reload in turn verifies the exact persisted
-Phase 6B proposal and complete Phase 6A identity.
+Phase 6C asks whether one exact persisted Phase 6B follow-up proposal is
+acceptable on its merits for possible advancement.  An identified reviewer
+records one immutable ``approved`` or ``rejected`` administrative review.
 
+Phase 6D asks whether, given that exact approved review and its complete
+authoritative provenance, an authorized governance actor ratifies advancement
+of the reviewed proposal into the next separately controlled phase.  The only
+positive Phase 6D decision is ``ratified``.  Ratification is immutable
+governance evidence; it does not grant any capability in Phase 6E.
+
+Eligibility and separation of duties
+------------------------------------
+
+Only one exact persisted, fully reloadable Phase 6C ``approved`` review is
+eligible.  A rejected, missing, malformed, stale, unsupported, or
+identity-inconsistent review fails closed.  The ratifier identity must differ
+byte-for-byte from the Phase 6C reviewer identity.  Self-ratification is
+rejected by pure construction, service and repository validation, a database
+check constraint, and the provenance trigger.
+
+The ratifier acts under the fixed version-1 role
+``follow_up_governance_ratifier``.  Callers cannot select or inject a different
+role.  Phase 6D never rebuilds the Phase 6A proposal or recomputes Phase 5
+assessment or policy truth; validated Phase 6C reload transitively validates
+the exact persisted Phase 6B proposal and embedded Phase 6A identity.
+

+bool ReviewIdentityMatchesPayload(
+    int reviewContractVersion,
+    const std::string& reviewCanonicalText,
+    const std::string& reviewIdentityHash,
+    long long followUpProposalId,
+    int proposalContractVersion,
+    const std::string& proposalCanonicalText,
+    const std::string& proposalIdentityHash,
+    RecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalReviewDecision reviewDecision,
+    const std::string& reviewerIdentity)
+{
+    const std::string marker =
+        ";reviewer=" + LengthPrefixed(reviewerIdentity) + ";reason=";
+    std::size_t markerPosition = reviewCanonicalText.find(marker);
+    while (markerPosition != std::string::npos)
+    {
+        const std::size_t lengthPosition = markerPosition + marker.size();
+        const std::size_t colonPosition =
+            reviewCanonicalText.find(':', lengthPosition);
+        if (colonPosition != std::string::npos &&
+            colonPosition > lengthPosition)
+        {
+            std::size_t reasonLength = 0U;
+            bool validLength = true;
+            for (std::size_t index = lengthPosition;
+                 index < colonPosition; ++index)
+            {
+                const unsigned char character =
+                    static_cast<unsigned char>(reviewCanonicalText[index]);
+                if (character < '0' || character > '9')
+                {
+                    validLength = false;
+                    break;
+                }
+                const std::size_t digit = character - '0';
+                if (reasonLength >
+                    (std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max() - digit) / 10U)
+                {
+                    validLength = false;
+                    break;
+                }
+                reasonLength = reasonLength * 10U + digit;
+            }
+            const std::size_t reasonPosition = colonPosition + 1U;
+            if (validLength && reasonLength ==
+                    reviewCanonicalText.size() - reasonPosition)
+            {
+                try
+                {
+                    const auto review =
+                        BuildRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalReview(
+                            reviewContractVersion, followUpProposalId,
+                            proposalContractVersion, proposalCanonicalText,
+                            proposalIdentityHash, reviewDecision,
+                            reviewerIdentity,
+                            reviewCanonicalText.substr(reasonPosition));
+                    if (review.identity.canonicalText == reviewCanonicalText &&
+                        review.identity.hash == reviewIdentityHash)
+                        return true;
+                }
+                catch (const std::exception&)
+                {
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        markerPosition = reviewCanonicalText.find(
+            marker, markerPosition + 1U);
+    }
+    return false;
+}

+bool ReviewIdentityMatchesPayload(
+    int reviewContractVersion,
+    const std::string& reviewCanonicalText,
+    const std::string& reviewIdentityHash,
+    long long followUpProposalId,
+    int proposalContractVersion,
+    const std::string& proposalCanonicalText,
+    const std::string& proposalIdentityHash,
+    RecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalReviewDecision reviewDecision,
+    const std::string& reviewerIdentity)
+{
+    const std::string marker =
+        ";reviewer=" + LengthPrefixed(reviewerIdentity) + ";reason=";
+    std::size_t markerPosition = reviewCanonicalText.find(marker);
+    while (markerPosition != std::string::npos)
+    {
+        const std::size_t lengthPosition = markerPosition + marker.size();
+        const std::size_t colonPosition =
+            reviewCanonicalText.find(':', lengthPosition);
+        if (colonPosition != std::string::npos &&
+            colonPosition > lengthPosition)
+        {
+            std::size_t reasonLength = 0U;
+            bool validLength = true;
+            for (std::size_t index = lengthPosition;
+                 index < colonPosition; ++index)
+            {
+                const unsigned char character =
+                    static_cast<unsigned char>(reviewCanonicalText[index]);
+                if (character < '0' || character > '9')
+                {
+                    validLength = false;
+                    break;
+                }
+                const std::size_t digit = character - '0';
+                if (reasonLength >
+                    (std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max() - digit) / 10U)
+                {
+                    validLength = false;
+                    break;
+                }
+                reasonLength = reasonLength * 10U + digit;
+            }
+            const std::size_t reasonPosition = colonPosition + 1U;
+            if (validLength && reasonLength ==
+                    reviewCanonicalText.size() - reasonPosition)
+            {
+                try
+                {
+                    const auto review =
+                        BuildRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalReview(
+                            reviewContractVersion, followUpProposalId,
+                            proposalContractVersion, proposalCanonicalText,
+                            proposalIdentityHash, reviewDecision,
+                            reviewerIdentity,
+                            reviewCanonicalText.substr(reasonPosition));
+                    if (review.identity.canonicalText == reviewCanonicalText &&
+                        review.identity.hash == reviewIdentityHash)
+                        return true;
+                }
+                catch (const std::exception&)
+                {
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        markerPosition = reviewCanonicalText.find(
+            marker, markerPosition + 1U);
+    }
+    return false;
+}

+bool ReviewIdentityMatchesPayload(
+    int reviewContractVersion,
+    const std::string& reviewCanonicalText,
+    const std::string& reviewIdentityHash,
+    long long followUpProposalId,
+    int proposalContractVersion,
+    const std::string& proposalCanonicalText,
+    const std::string& proposalIdentityHash,
+    RecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalReviewDecision reviewDecision,
+    const std::string& reviewerIdentity)
+{
+    const std::string marker =
+        ";reviewer=" + LengthPrefixed(reviewerIdentity) + ";reason=";
+    std::size_t markerPosition = reviewCanonicalText.find(marker);
+    while (markerPosition != std::string::npos)
+    {
+        const std::size_t lengthPosition = markerPosition + marker.size();
+        const std::size_t colonPosition =
+            reviewCanonicalText.find(':', lengthPosition);
+        if (colonPosition != std::string::npos &&
+            colonPosition > lengthPosition)
+        {
+            std::size_t reasonLength = 0U;
+            bool validLength = true;
+            for (std::size_t index = lengthPosition;
+                 index < colonPosition; ++index)
+            {
+                const unsigned char character =
+                    static_cast<unsigned char>(reviewCanonicalText[index]);
+                if (character < '0' || character > '9')
+                {
+                    validLength = false;
+                    break;
+                }
+                const std::size_t digit = character - '0';
+                if (reasonLength >
+                    (std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max() - digit) / 10U)
+                {
+                    validLength = false;
+                    break;
+                }
+                reasonLength = reasonLength * 10U + digit;
+            }
+            const std::size_t reasonPosition = colonPosition + 1U;
+            if (validLength && reasonLength ==
+                    reviewCanonicalText.size() - reasonPosition)
+            {
+                try
+                {
+                    const auto review =
+                        BuildRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalReview(
+                            reviewContractVersion, followUpProposalId,
+                            proposalContractVersion, proposalCanonicalText,
+                            proposalIdentityHash, reviewDecision,
+                            reviewerIdentity,
+                            reviewCanonicalText.substr(reasonPosition));
+                    if (review.identity.canonicalText == reviewCanonicalText &&
+                        review.identity.hash == reviewIdentityHash)
+                        return true;
+                }
+                catch (const std::exception&)
+                {
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        markerPosition = reviewCanonicalText.find(
+            marker, markerPosition + 1U);
+    }
+    return false;
+}

+bool ReviewIdentityMatchesPayload(
+    int reviewContractVersion,
+    const std::string& reviewCanonicalText,
+    const std::string& reviewIdentityHash,
+    long long followUpProposalId,
+    int proposalContractVersion,
+    const std::string& proposalCanonicalText,
+    const std::string& proposalIdentityHash,
+    RecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalReviewDecision reviewDecision,
+    const std::string& reviewerIdentity)
+{
+    const std::string marker =
+        ";reviewer=" + LengthPrefixed(reviewerIdentity) + ";reason=";
+    std::size_t markerPosition = reviewCanonicalText.find(marker);
+    while (markerPosition != std::string::npos)
+    {
+        const std::size_t lengthPosition = markerPosition + marker.size();
+        const std::size_t colonPosition =
+            reviewCanonicalText.find(':', lengthPosition);
+        if (colonPosition != std::string::npos &&
+            colonPosition > lengthPosition)
+        {
+            std::size_t reasonLength = 0U;
+            bool validLength = true;
+            for (std::size_t index = lengthPosition;
+                 index < colonPosition; ++index)
+            {
+                const unsigned char character =
+                    static_cast<unsigned char>(reviewCanonicalText[index]);
+                if (character < '0' || character > '9')
+                {
+                    validLength = false;
+                    break;
+                }
+                const std::size_t digit = character - '0';
+                if (reasonLength >
+                    (std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max() - digit) / 10U)
+                {
+                    validLength = false;
+                    break;
+                }
+                reasonLength = reasonLength * 10U + digit;
+            }
+            const std::size_t reasonPosition = colonPosition + 1U;
+            if (validLength && reasonLength ==
+                    reviewCanonicalText.size() - reasonPosition)
+            {
+                try
+                {
+                    const auto review =
+                        BuildRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalReview(
+                            reviewContractVersion, followUpProposalId,
+                            proposalContractVersion, proposalCanonicalText,
+                            proposalIdentityHash, reviewDecision,
+                            reviewerIdentity,
+                            reviewCanonicalText.substr(reasonPosition));
+                    if (review.identity.canonicalText == reviewCanonicalText &&
+                        review.identity.hash == reviewIdentityHash)
+                        return true;
+                }
+                catch (const std::exception&)
+                {
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        markerPosition = reviewCanonicalText.find(
+            marker, markerPosition + 1U);
+    }
+    return false;
+}

+bool ReviewIdentityMatchesPayload(
+    int reviewContractVersion,
+    const std::string& reviewCanonicalText,
+    const std::string& reviewIdentityHash,
+    long long followUpProposalId,
+    int proposalContractVersion,
+    const std::string& proposalCanonicalText,
+    const std::string& proposalIdentityHash,
+    RecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalReviewDecision reviewDecision,
+    const std::string& reviewerIdentity)
+{
+    const std::string marker =
+        ";reviewer=" + LengthPrefixed(reviewerIdentity) + ";reason=";
+    std::size_t markerPosition = reviewCanonicalText.find(marker);
+    while (markerPosition != std::string::npos)
+    {
+        const std::size_t lengthPosition = markerPosition + marker.size();
+        const std::size_t colonPosition =
+            reviewCanonicalText.find(':', lengthPosition);
+        if (colonPosition != std::string::npos &&
+            colonPosition > lengthPosition)
+        {
+            std::size_t reasonLength = 0U;
+            bool validLength = true;
+            for (std::size_t index = lengthPosition;
+                 index < colonPosition; ++index)
+            {
+                const unsigned char character =
+                    static_cast<unsigned char>(reviewCanonicalText[index]);
+                if (character < '0' || character > '9')
+                {
+                    validLength = false;
+                    break;
+                }
+                const std::size_t digit = character - '0';
+                if (reasonLength >
+                    (std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max() - digit) / 10U)
+                {
+                    validLength = false;
+                    break;
+                }
+                reasonLength = reasonLength * 10U + digit;
+            }
+            const std::size_t reasonPosition = colonPosition + 1U;
+            if (validLength && reasonLength ==
+                    reviewCanonicalText.size() - reasonPosition)
+            {
+                try
+                {
+                    const auto review =

+authoritative provenance, an authorized governance actor ratifies advancement
+of the reviewed proposal into the next separately controlled phase.  The only
+positive Phase 6D decision is ``ratified``.  Ratification is immutable
+governance evidence; it does not grant any capability in Phase 6E.
+
+Eligibility and separation of duties
+------------------------------------
+
+Only one exact persisted, fully reloadable Phase 6C ``approved`` review is
+eligible.  A rejected, missing, malformed, stale, unsupported, or
+identity-inconsistent review fails closed.  The ratifier identity must differ
+byte-for-byte from the Phase 6C reviewer identity.  Self-ratification is
+rejected by pure construction, service and repository validation, a database
+check constraint, and the provenance trigger.
+
+The ratifier acts under the fixed version-1 role
+``follow_up_governance_ratifier``.  Callers cannot select or inject a different
+role.  Phase 6D never rebuilds the Phase 6A proposal or recomputes Phase 5
+assessment or policy truth; validated Phase 6C reload transitively validates
+the exact persisted Phase 6B proposal and embedded Phase 6A identity.
+

+bool ReviewIdentityMatchesPayload(
+    int reviewContractVersion,
+    const std::string& reviewCanonicalText,
+    const std::string& reviewIdentityHash,
+    long long followUpProposalId,
+    int proposalContractVersion,
+    const std::string& proposalCanonicalText,
+    const std::string& proposalIdentityHash,
+    RecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalReviewDecision reviewDecision,
+    const std::string& reviewerIdentity)
+{
+    const std::string marker =
+        ";reviewer=" + LengthPrefixed(reviewerIdentity) + ";reason=";
+    std::size_t markerPosition = reviewCanonicalText.find(marker);
+    while (markerPosition != std::string::npos)
+    {
+        const std::size_t lengthPosition = markerPosition + marker.size();
+        const std::size_t colonPosition =
+            reviewCanonicalText.find(':', lengthPosition);
+        if (colonPosition != std::string::npos &&
+            colonPosition > lengthPosition)
+        {
+            std::size_t reasonLength = 0U;
+            bool validLength = true;
+            for (std::size_t index = lengthPosition;
+                 index < colonPosition; ++index)
+            {
+                const unsigned char character =
+                    static_cast<unsigned char>(reviewCanonicalText[index]);
+                if (character < '0' || character > '9')
+                {
+                    validLength = false;
+                    break;
+                }
+                const std::size_t digit = character - '0';
+                if (reasonLength >
+                    (std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max() - digit) / 10U)
+                {
+                    validLength = false;
+                    break;
+                }
+                reasonLength = reasonLength * 10U + digit;
+            }
+            const std::size_t reasonPosition = colonPosition + 1U;
+            if (validLength && reasonLength ==
+                    reviewCanonicalText.size() - reasonPosition)
+            {
+                try
+                {
+                    const auto review =
+                        BuildRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalReview(
+                            reviewContractVersion, followUpProposalId,
+                            proposalContractVersion, proposalCanonicalText,
+                            proposalIdentityHash, reviewDecision,
+                            reviewerIdentity,
+                            reviewCanonicalText.substr(reasonPosition));
+                    if (review.identity.canonicalText == reviewCanonicalText &&
+                        review.identity.hash == reviewIdentityHash)
+                        return true;
+                }
+                catch (const std::exception&)
+                {
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        markerPosition = reviewCanonicalText.find(
+            marker, markerPosition + 1U);
+    }
+    return false;
+}

+bool ReviewIdentityMatchesPayload(
+    int reviewContractVersion,
+    const std::string& reviewCanonicalText,
+    const std::string& reviewIdentityHash,
+    long long followUpProposalId,
+    int proposalContractVersion,
+    const std::string& proposalCanonicalText,
+    const std::string& proposalIdentityHash,
+    RecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalReviewDecision reviewDecision,
+    const std::string& reviewerIdentity)
+{
+    const std::string marker =
+        ";reviewer=" + LengthPrefixed(reviewerIdentity) + ";reason=";
+    std::size_t markerPosition = reviewCanonicalText.find(marker);
+    while (markerPosition != std::string::npos)
+    {
+        const std::size_t lengthPosition = markerPosition + marker.size();
+        const std::size_t colonPosition =
+            reviewCanonicalText.find(':', lengthPosition);
+        if (colonPosition != std::string::npos &&
+            colonPosition > lengthPosition)
+        {
+            std::size_t reasonLength = 0U;
+            bool validLength = true;
+            for (std::size_t index = lengthPosition;
+                 index < colonPosition; ++index)
+            {
+                const unsigned char character =
+                    static_cast<unsigned char>(reviewCanonicalText[index]);
+                if (character < '0' || character > '9')
+                {
+                    validLength = false;
+                    break;
+                }
+                const std::size_t digit = character - '0';
+                if (reasonLength >
+                    (std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max() - digit) / 10U)
+                {
+                    validLength = false;
+                    break;
+                }
+                reasonLength = reasonLength * 10U + digit;
+            }
+            const std::size_t reasonPosition = colonPosition + 1U;
+            if (validLength && reasonLength ==
+                    reviewCanonicalText.size() - reasonPosition)
+            {
+                try
+                {
+                    const auto review =
+                        BuildRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalReview(
+                            reviewContractVersion, followUpProposalId,
+                            proposalContractVersion, proposalCanonicalText,
+                            proposalIdentityHash, reviewDecision,
+                            reviewerIdentity,
+                            reviewCanonicalText.substr(reasonPosition));
+                    if (review.identity.canonicalText == reviewCanonicalText &&
+                        review.identity.hash == reviewIdentityHash)
+                        return true;
+                }
+                catch (const std::exception&)
+                {
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        markerPosition = reviewCanonicalText.find(
+            marker, markerPosition + 1U);
+    }
+    return false;
+}

## 1. Executive summary

Phase 6D has been corrected from a duplicative administrative approval into a distinct, immutable governance ratification.

The blocking architectural defect is resolved while preserving the existing deterministic identity, provenance, append-only persistence, replay, concurrency, least-privilege, and service-boundary mechanics.

Branch remains `phase6d` at `9689d7d14f6354610525ca8dc9e430af06350862`; `phase6c-complete` is an ancestor. All work remains uncommitted and unstaged.

## 2. Phase 6C versus Phase 6D

- Phase 6C decides whether an exact persisted follow-up proposal is acceptable on its merits for possible advancement.
- Phase 6D decides whether an authorized governance ratifier ratifies the exact approved Phase 6C review for entry into the next separately controlled phase.
- Phase 6D consumes one exact, valid, approved Phase 6C review plus its complete Phase 6B and embedded Phase 6A provenance.
- Ratification grants no Phase 6E capability and cannot activate, execute, queue, schedule, signal workers, mutate experiments/models, advance continuation chains, or declare success.

## 3. Separation of duties

The enforced policy is:

```text
ratifier_identity != Phase 6C reviewer_identity
```

No contrary committed repository authority was found.

The fixed authority role is:

```text
follow_up_governance_ratifier
```

Callers cannot inject another role. Separation is enforced by pure construction, exact review-canonical validation, service checks, repository validation, database constraints, the provenance trigger, tests, and documentation.

The uncommitted Phase 6D Approval filename family was comprehensively renamed to Ratification. Because those files were untracked, Git reports the corrected files as additions rather than rename records. No obsolete Approval implementation file remains.

## 5. Domain contract and identity

The corrected immutable value includes:

- Contract version.
- Exact Phase 6C review event ID, version, canonical text, and hash.
- Exact Phase 6B proposal ID, version, canonical text, and hash.
- Upstream `approved` decision and reviewer identity.
- Fixed ratification role.
- Phase 6D `ratified` decision.
- Ratifier identity and ratification basis.
- Explicit separation-of-duties semantics.
- Fixed negative operational-authority declarations.

Canonical identity uses:

```text
experiment_recommendation_campaign_follow_up_proposal_ratification_v1
```

It uses locale-independent integer formatting, byte-length framing, strict UTF-8/control-character validation, and canonical-first hash checking. Generated IDs and timestamps remain outside identity.

The fixed golden hash is:

```text
fnv1a64:caf47db05ce89408
```

The pure builder reconstructs and validates the exact Phase 6C review from its canonical payload, preventing a caller from supplying a forged reviewer alongside an unrelated valid review hash.

## 6. Migration 044 and privileges

Migration 044 provides:

- One append-only ratification per exact eligible review/proposal.
- Approved-review enforcement.
- Complete Phase 6C/6B provenance constraints.
- Database-level reviewer/ratifier separation.
- Fixed role and `ratified` decision checks.
- Bytewise canonical collation.
- Generated immutable ID and timestamp.
- Deterministic uniqueness.
- Invoker-rights provenance trigger with a pinned safe search path.
- PostgreSQL identifiers kept within the 63-byte limit.
- PUBLIC and runtime function execution revocation.
- Runtime `SELECT`, column-scoped `INSERT`, and sequence `USAGE` only.
- No update, delete, truncate, generated-column insertion, or trigger-function execution authority.
- Clean installation, upgrade from 043, and repeatability.

NULL-ACL fallback coverage is preserved for functions, tables, and sequences, including lowercase:

```sql
acldefault('s', sequence_owner)
```

## 7. Repository behavior

The repository now:

- Validates the pure ratification before persistence.
- Takes a transaction-scoped advisory lock over the exact review-event conflict domain.
- Reloads and validates the exact Phase 6C review and transitive Phase 6B proposal.
- Enforces approved eligibility and separation of duties.
- Returns `recorded` for the first valid write.
- Returns `existing_identical` for exact replay.
- Rejects changed ratifier, basis, role, provenance, or canonical payload.
- Converges equivalent concurrent writes.
- Deterministically rejects conflicting concurrent writes.
- Treats canonical content as authoritative over hashes.
- Leaves no partial ratification after rollback.
- Keeps lookups and lists read-only without upstream mutation or sequence advancement.

## 8. Service behavior

`RatifyRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposal` accepts only:

- Exact review-event ID.
- Expected review identity hash.
- Ratifier identity.
- Ratification basis.

It validates request syntax, opens one transaction, reloads the review, verifies identity and approved eligibility, enforces separation of duties, constructs the pure value once, persists atomically, and returns the authoritative stored result.

It exposes no operational capability or CLI entry point.

+bool ReviewIdentityMatchesPayload(
+    int reviewContractVersion,
+    const std::string& reviewCanonicalText,
+    const std::string& reviewIdentityHash,
+    long long followUpProposalId,
+    int proposalContractVersion,
+    const std::string& proposalCanonicalText,
+    const std::string& proposalIdentityHash,
+    RecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalReviewDecision reviewDecision,
+    const std::string& reviewerIdentity)
+{
+    const std::string marker =
+        ";reviewer=" + LengthPrefixed(reviewerIdentity) + ";reason=";
+    std::size_t markerPosition = reviewCanonicalText.find(marker);
+    while (markerPosition != std::string::npos)
+    {
+        const std::size_t lengthPosition = markerPosition + marker.size();
+        const std::size_t colonPosition =
+            reviewCanonicalText.find(':', lengthPosition);
+        if (colonPosition != std::string::npos &&
+            colonPosition > lengthPosition)
+        {
+            std::size_t reasonLength = 0U;
+            bool validLength = true;
+            for (std::size_t index = lengthPosition;
+                 index < colonPosition; ++index)
+            {
+                const unsigned char character =
+                    static_cast<unsigned char>(reviewCanonicalText[index]);
+                if (character < '0' || character > '9')
+                {
+                    validLength = false;
+                    break;
+                }
+                const std::size_t digit = character - '0';
+                if (reasonLength >
+                    (std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max() - digit) / 10U)
+                {
+                    validLength = false;
+                    break;
+                }
+                reasonLength = reasonLength * 10U + digit;
+            }
+            const std::size_t reasonPosition = colonPosition + 1U;
+            if (validLength && reasonLength ==
+                    reviewCanonicalText.size() - reasonPosition)
+            {
+                try
+                {
+                    const auto review =
+                        BuildRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalReview(
+                            reviewContractVersion, followUpProposalId,
+                            proposalContractVersion, proposalCanonicalText,
+                            proposalIdentityHash, reviewDecision,
+                            reviewerIdentity,
+                            reviewCanonicalText.substr(reasonPosition));
+                    if (review.identity.canonicalText == reviewCanonicalText &&
+                        review.identity.hash == reviewIdentityHash)
+                        return true;
+                }

-Phase 6D Recommendation Campaign Follow-Up Proposal Administrative Ratification
-============================================================================
+Phase 6D Recommendation Campaign Follow-Up Proposal Governance Ratification
+===========================================================================
 
-Purpose and recovered roadmap
------------------------------
+Purpose and distinct authority
+------------------------------
 
-Phase 6D records one immutable administrative ratification for one exact eligible
-Phase 6C follow-up-proposal review event.  The committed Phase 6A roadmap
-separates Phase 6B--6F into persistence, review, ratification/rejection,
-activation, and execution concerns.  Phase 6C uses ``approved`` and
-``rejected`` as its review outcomes, but explicitly defines an approved review
-as evidence for possible consideration by a later separately authorized
-phase.  Phase 6D is that distinct administrative ratification boundary; it is not
-the later activation or execution boundary.
+Phase 6C and Phase 6D answer different governance questions.
 
-Only an exact persisted Phase 6C ``approved`` review is eligible.  A rejected,
-missing, malformed, stale, identity-inconsistent, or unsupported review cannot
-be approved.  Phase 6D never rebuilds the Phase 6A proposal or recomputes the
-Phase 5 assessment/policy decision.  It loads the authoritative Phase 6C
-record, whose validated repository reload in turn verifies the exact persisted
-Phase 6B proposal and complete Phase 6A identity.
+Phase 6C asks whether one exact persisted Phase 6B follow-up proposal is
+acceptable on its merits for possible advancement.  An identified reviewer
+records one immutable ``approved`` or ``rejected`` administrative review.
 
+Phase 6D asks whether, given that exact approved review and its complete
+authoritative provenance, an authorized governance actor ratifies advancement
+of the reviewed proposal into the next separately controlled phase.  The only
+positive Phase 6D decision is ``ratified``.  Ratification is immutable
+governance evidence; it does not grant any capability in Phase 6E.
+
+Eligibility and separation of duties
+------------------------------------
+
+Only one exact persisted, fully reloadable Phase 6C ``approved`` review is
+eligible.  A rejected, missing, malformed, stale, unsupported, or
+identity-inconsistent review fails closed.  The ratifier identity must differ

## 1. Executive summary

Phase 6D has been corrected from a duplicative administrative approval into a distinct, immutable governance ratification.

The blocking architectural defect is resolved while preserving the existing deterministic identity, provenance, append-only persistence, replay, concurrency, least-privilege, and service-boundary mechanics.

Branch remains `phase6d` at `9689d7d14f6354610525ca8dc9e430af06350862`; `phase6c-complete` is an ancestor. All work remains uncommitted and unstaged.

## 2. Phase 6C versus Phase 6D

- Phase 6C decides whether an exact persisted follow-up proposal is acceptable on its merits for possible advancement.
- Phase 6D decides whether an authorized governance ratifier ratifies the exact approved Phase 6C review for entry into the next separately controlled phase.
- Phase 6D consumes one exact, valid, approved Phase 6C review plus its complete Phase 6B and embedded Phase 6A provenance.
- Ratification grants no Phase 6E capability and cannot activate, execute, queue, schedule, signal workers, mutate experiments/models, advance continuation chains, or declare success.

## 3. Separation of duties

The enforced policy is:

```text
ratifier_identity != Phase 6C reviewer_identity
```

No contrary committed repository authority was found.

The fixed authority role is:

```text
follow_up_governance_ratifier
```

Callers cannot inject another role. Separation is enforced by pure construction, exact review-canonical validation, service checks, repository validation, database constraints, the provenance trigger, tests, and documentation.

## 4. Files changed

The uncommitted Phase 6D Approval filename family was comprehensively renamed to Ratification. Because those files were untracked, Git reports the corrected files as additions rather than rename records. No obsolete Approval implementation file remains.

## 5. Domain contract and identity

The corrected immutable value includes:

- Contract version.
- Exact Phase 6C review event ID, version, canonical text, and hash.
- Exact Phase 6B proposal ID, version, canonical text, and hash.
- Upstream `approved` decision and reviewer identity.
- Fixed ratification role.
- Phase 6D `ratified` decision.
- Ratifier identity and ratification basis.
- Explicit separation-of-duties semantics.
- Fixed negative operational-authority declarations.

Canonical identity uses:

```text
experiment_recommendation_campaign_follow_up_proposal_ratification_v1
```

It uses locale-independent integer formatting, byte-length framing, strict UTF-8/control-character validation, and canonical-first hash checking. Generated IDs and timestamps remain outside identity.

The fixed golden hash is:

```text
fnv1a64:caf47db05ce89408
```

The pure builder reconstructs and validates the exact Phase 6C review from its canonical payload, preventing a caller from supplying a forged reviewer alongside an unrelated valid review hash.

## 6. Migration 044 and privileges

Migration 044 provides:

- One append-only ratification per exact eligible review/proposal.
- Approved-review enforcement.
- Complete Phase 6C/6B provenance constraints.
- Database-level reviewer/ratifier separation.
- Fixed role and `ratified` decision checks.
- Bytewise canonical collation.
- Generated immutable ID and timestamp.
- Deterministic uniqueness.
- Invoker-rights provenance trigger with a pinned safe search path.
- PostgreSQL identifiers kept within the 63-byte limit.
- PUBLIC and runtime function execution revocation.
- Runtime `SELECT`, column-scoped `INSERT`, and sequence `USAGE` only.
- No update, delete, truncate, generated-column insertion, or trigger-function execution authority.
- Clean installation, upgrade from 043, and repeatability.

NULL-ACL fallback coverage is preserved for functions, tables, and sequences, including lowercase:

```sql
acldefault('s', sequence_owner)
```

## 7. Repository behavior

The repository now:

- Validates the pure ratification before persistence.
- Takes a transaction-scoped advisory lock over the exact review-event conflict domain.
- Reloads and validates the exact Phase 6C review and transitive Phase 6B proposal.
- Enforces approved eligibility and separation of duties.
- Returns `recorded` for the first valid write.
- Returns `existing_identical` for exact replay.
- Rejects changed ratifier, basis, role, provenance, or canonical payload.
- Converges equivalent concurrent writes.
- Deterministically rejects conflicting concurrent writes.
- Treats canonical content as authoritative over hashes.
- Leaves no partial ratification after rollback.
- Keeps lookups and lists read-only without upstream mutation or sequence advancement.

## 8. Service behavior

`RatifyRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposal` accepts only:

- Exact review-event ID.
- Expected review identity hash.
- Ratifier identity.
- Ratification basis.

It validates request syntax, opens one transaction, reloads the review, verifies identity and approved eligibility, enforces separation of duties, constructs the pure value once, persists atomically, and returns the authoritative stored result.

It exposes no operational capability or CLI entry point.
